results.question: What is our total revenue?

cards.title: Total Revenue
cards.sql: SELECT sum(net_amount_usd) AS total_revenue FROM core.fct_order_lines

results.question: What was the gross revenue in 2023?

cards.title: Gross revenue in 2023
cards.sql: SELECT sum(core.fct_order_lines.gross_amount_usd) FROM core.fct_order_lines INNER JOIN core.dim_date ON core.fct_order_lines.order_date = core.dim_date.date_day WHERE core.dim_date.year = 2023

results.question: How many orders were placed in 2024?

cards.title: Orders in 2024
cards.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT order_key) FROM core.fct_order_lines JOIN core.dim_date ON core.fct_order_lines.order_date = core.dim_date.date_day WHERE core.dim_date.year = 2024

results.question: How many customers do we have?

cards.title: Registered Customers
cards.sql: SELECT count(*) AS registered_customer_count FROM core.dim_customer

cards.title: Buying Customers
cards.sql: SELECT count(distinct customer_key) AS buying_customer_count FROM core.fct_order_lines

results.question: How many customers bought something in 2025?

cards.title: Customers who bought something in 2025
cards.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT customer_key) FROM core.fct_order_lines JOIN core.dim_date ON core.fct_order_lines.order_date = core.dim_date.date_day WHERE core.dim_date.year = 2025

results.question: What is the average delivery time in days?

cards.title: Average online delivery time
cards.sql: SELECT avg(delivery_days) FROM core.fct_order_lines WHERE line_number = 0

results.question: How many orders took more than 7 days to deliver?

cards.title: Orders with more than 7 days delivery time
cards.sql: SELECT count(order_key) FROM core.fct_order_lines WHERE delivery_days > 7

results.question: What is the net revenue of the online store compared to physical stores?

cards.title: Net Revenue by Sales Channel
cards.sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN s.sales_channel = 'Online' THEN 'Online Store'
    ELSE 'Physical Stores'
  END AS sales_channel,
  sum(ol.net_amount_usd) AS net_revenue
FROM core.fct_order_lines AS ol
JOIN core.dim_store AS s
  ON ol.store_key = s.store_key
GROUP BY
  s.sales_channel

cards.title: Total Net Revenue
cards.sql:
SELECT
  sum(net_amount_usd) AS total_net_revenue
FROM core.fct_order_lines

results.question: What is the net revenue from orders of customers paying in euros, expressed in euros?

cards.title: Net revenue in EUR
cards.sql: SELECT sum(core.fct_order_lines.net_amount_local) AS net_revenue_eur FROM core.fct_order_lines WHERE core.fct_order_lines.currency_code = 'EUR'

results.question: Which 3 product categories had the highest margin in 2025, and how much was it?

cards.title: Top 3 Product Categories by Margin in 2025
cards.sql:
SELECT
  dp.category_name,
  sum(fol.net_amount_usd - fol.cost_amount_usd) AS margin_usd
FROM core.fct_order_lines AS fol
JOIN core.dim_product AS dp
  ON fol.product_key = dp.product_key
JOIN core.dim_date AS dd
  ON fol.order_date = dd.date_day
WHERE
  dd.year = 2025
GROUP BY
  dp.category_name
ORDER BY
  margin_usd DESC
LIMIT 3

results.question: What share of gross revenue do we give away in discounts?

cards.title: Share of Gross Revenue in Discounts
cards.sql: SELECT round(sum(core.fct_order_lines.discount_amount_usd) / nullif(sum(core.fct_order_lines.gross_amount_usd), 0)::numeric, 4) FROM core.fct_order_lines

results.question: What is the margin rate of each product category?

cards.title: Margin rate by product category
cards.sql:
SELECT
  dp.category_name,
  sum(fct.margin_amount_usd) / sum(fct.net_amount_usd) AS margin_rate
FROM core.fct_order_lines AS fct
JOIN core.dim_product AS dp
  ON fct.product_key = dp.product_key
GROUP BY
  dp.category_name
ORDER BY
  margin_rate DESC
LIMIT 10;

results.question: How many stores do we have?

cards.title: Number of stores
cards.sql: SELECT count(distinct store_code) FROM core.dim_store

results.question: How many stores are open today?

cards.title: Active Stores
cards.sql: SELECT count(core.dim_store.store_code) FROM core.dim_store WHERE core.dim_store.status = 'Active'

results.question: How did net revenue develop year by year?

cards.title: Net revenue by year
cards.sql:
SELECT
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dd.date_day) AS order_year,
  sum(fol.net_amount_usd) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM core.fct_order_lines AS fol
JOIN core.dim_date AS dd
  ON fol.order_date = dd.date_day
GROUP BY
  order_year
ORDER BY
  order_year

results.question: What was the average order value in 2024?

cards.title: Average order value in 2024
cards.sql:
SELECT avg_order_value_usd FROM
  (
    SELECT
      sum(net_amount_usd) / count(distinct order_key) AS avg_order_value_usd
    FROM
      core.fct_order_lines
    INNER JOIN core.dim_date ON core.fct_order_lines.order_date = core.dim_date.date_day
    WHERE
      core.dim_date.year = 2024
  ) AS sub

results.question: How much net revenue came from customers who were younger than 30 when they ordered?

cards.title: Net revenue from customers younger than 30
cards.sql: SELECT sum(core.fct_order_lines.net_amount_usd) FROM core.fct_order_lines WHERE core.fct_order_lines.customer_age < 30

results.question: Customers from which country generated the most net revenue, and how much?

cards.title: Net revenue by customer country
cards.sql:
SELECT
  dc.country_name,
  sum(fct_order_lines.net_amount_usd) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM
  core.fct_order_lines
JOIN
  core.dim_customer AS dc
ON
  fct_order_lines.customer_key = dc.customer_key
GROUP BY
  dc.country_name
ORDER BY
  net_revenue_usd DESC
LIMIT 10

cards.title: Top customer country by net revenue
cards.sql:
SELECT
  dc.country_name,
  sum(fct_order_lines.net_amount_usd) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM
  core.fct_order_lines
JOIN
  core.dim_customer AS dc
ON
  fct_order_lines.customer_key = dc.customer_key
GROUP BY
  dc.country_name
ORDER BY
  net_revenue_usd DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: How much net revenue was made on working days and how much on other days?

cards.title: Net Revenue by Day Type
cards.sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN d.is_working_day THEN 'Working Day'
    ELSE 'Other Day'
  END AS day_type,
  sum(ol.net_amount_usd) AS net_revenue
FROM core.fct_order_lines AS ol
JOIN core.dim_date AS d
  ON ol.order_date = d.date_day
GROUP BY
  d.is_working_day

cards.title: Net Revenue on Working Days
cards.sql:
SELECT
  sum(ol.net_amount_usd)
FROM core.fct_order_lines AS ol
JOIN core.dim_date AS d
  ON ol.order_date = d.date_day
WHERE
  d.is_working_day

cards.title: Net Revenue on Other Days
cards.sql:
SELECT
  sum(ol.net_amount_usd)
FROM core.fct_order_lines AS ol
JOIN core.dim_date AS d
  ON ol.order_date = d.date_day
WHERE
  NOT d.is_working_day

results.question: Which 5 brands sold the most units?

cards.title: Top 5 Brands by Units Sold
cards.sql:
SELECT
  d.brand,
  sum(ol.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM core.fct_order_lines AS ol
JOIN core.dim_product AS d
  ON ol.product_key = d.product_key
GROUP BY
  d.brand
ORDER BY
  units_sold DESC
LIMIT 5
